sources: Flare 2.0 热身 v2 / 练后三档 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，练后：侧卧直腿外展）

purpose.zh: 练臀部外侧，让髋在分腿和摆腿动作里更稳
purpose.en: Works the outside of your hip so it holds steady in straddle and leg-swing moves.

text.zh: 脚尖朝前，脚跟带着直腿往上抬
text.en: Toes forward, lead with the heel, leg straight

text.zh: 侧躺，下面手臂撑着，上面的手扶在胯上，身体一条直线。
text.en: Lie on your side propped on the lower forearm, top hand on the hip, body in a line.

text.zh: 上面的腿伸直，脚尖朝前不朝天，腿略在身体后方。
text.en: Top leg straight, toes pointing forward not up, leg slightly behind the body.

text.zh: 胯不往后翻，腿慢慢落下，中间不在下面腿上休息。
text.en: Hips stay stacked; lower slowly without resting on the bottom leg.

commonErrors.en: Turning the toes up to the ceiling.

cautions.zh: 胯外侧刺疼就减小高度
cautions.en: If the outside of your hip hurts sharply, lift lower.

training.source: flare2 r2 animation tempo (4 s per rep: 1.1 s up, 0.7 s top, 1.4 s down, 0.8 s pause); 表：剂量未写，草稿每侧 10 次

flare2.camera: 正前略高（看得到抬腿高度、脚尖方向和骨盆不后翻）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：侧卧直腿外展；草稿每侧 10 次 1 组（次数待定）；动画左侧卧抬右腿示范，App 镜像
flare2.note: Animation r2: lying on the left side, right leg lifts ~35 deg, heel first, toes forward, hip slightly extended; pelvis fixed (no roll-back). One side shown, the app mirrors.

reminders.zh: 脚尖朝前，脚跟带着腿走
reminders.en: Toes forward, the heel leads the leg

reminders.zh: 胯别往后翻，腿不靠下面
reminders.en: Hips stacked, top leg stays off
